entries.text: God Mode has a new All rules screen. 89 rules that used to be fixed are now settings: what each level sees, who can edit and assign work, which work item fields staff can change, notification and digest rules, chat, wiki and quick link rights, sign-in and file limits, and display defaults.
New accounts can start with a chosen work item layout, grouping and order, Home widgets, timeline order and more. A button applies them to existing members.
What directors see in the sidebar and in KPI is now a setting.
Risky rules need the confirmation phrase, every change is recorded in the audit log, and any rule can be reset to its default.
Nothing changes until an admin changes a rule: every rule starts at today's behavior.
